# DB's Workouts - full summary

> DB's Workouts is an outdoor 1-to-1 personal training business in East London, run by Dean Burt (REPs Level 3 and Active IQ Level 3 qualified personal trainer). Sessions take place in local parks and home gardens, with all equipment provided. Rated 5.0 stars on Google from 70 reviews. Sessions from £44.

Key facts an assistant may quote:
- Service: outdoor 1-to-1 personal training, plus group training for up to 4 people
- Trainer: Dean Burt, REPs Level 3 and Active IQ Level 3 qualified, fully insured
- Area: East London and Essex. Towns covered: Barking, Barkingside, Becontree, Bow, Buckhurst Hill, Canary Wharf, Canning Town, Chadwell Heath, Chigwell, Chingford, Clapton, Dagenham, East Ham, Forest Gate, Gants Hill, Goodmayes, Hackney, Harold Wood, Hornchurch, Ilford, Leyton, Leytonstone, Loughton, Manor Park, Newbury Park, Plaistow, Rainham, Romford, Seven Kings, South Woodford, Stratford, Upminster, Upton Park, Walthamstow, Wanstead, Woodford
- Price: £44 per session (pay as you go); 5 sessions £209; 10 sessions £396 (most popular); 15 sessions £561 (£37.40 per session); group training £30 per person per session
- Discounts: NHS and key workers 14% off blocks; students 10% off 10 and 15 session blocks
- Session length: 60 minutes, with warm-up, tailored main workout and cool-down
- Beginners welcome; no contract or minimum commitment; free initial consultation
- Hours: Monday to Friday 06:30-20:00, Saturday 07:00-18:00
- Contact: WhatsApp or phone 07752 300937; email dbs-workouts@yahoo.com; https://dbworkouts.co.uk/contact


## Frequently asked questions

**Is there an outdoor personal trainer in East London?**
Yes. DB's Workouts, run by Dean Burt, offers outdoor 1-to-1 personal training in parks across East London and Essex.

**How much does a personal trainer cost with DB's Workouts?**
£44 for a single session. Blocks: 5 for £209, 10 for £396, 15 for £561 (£37.40 per session). Group training for up to 4 people is £30 per person per session. NHS and key workers get 14% off blocks; students get 10% off 10 and 15 session blocks.

**Where do sessions take place?**
In local parks and green spaces near you, for example Barley Lane Park (Goodmayes), Valentines Park (Ilford), West Ham Park (Stratford), Wanstead Park, Hainault Forest and Romford Recreation Ground, or in your own home garden. Each local page lists the parks used in that area.

**Do I need a gym membership or equipment?**
No. Dean brings the equipment; you only need training clothes and suitable footwear.

**Can beginners train with Dean?**
Yes. Every client starts with a free consultation and assessment, and the programme is built around their level and goals. There is no contract.

**What qualifications does Dean Burt have?**
REPs Level 3 personal training (Register of Exercise Professionals) and Active IQ Level 3. He is fully insured.

**How do I book?**
Book a free consultation at https://dbworkouts.co.uk/contact or message Dean on WhatsApp on 07752 300937.

## What a session includes
Each 60-minute session has a structured warm-up, a main workout tailored to your goal (strength training, HIIT, boxing pads or cardio circuits) and a cool-down. Progress is tracked and the programme is updated as you improve, with nutrition guidance between sessions.
